_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/damage/test_replace_damage.py. t_rd_flail is Inquisitor's Flail -- two replace_damage statics, one filtered on the dealer and one on the recipient, both combat-only -- plus its equip. t_rd_furnace is Furnace of Rath: no filter on either end and no combat clause, so it reaches a burn spell and a player alike. t_rd_bear and t_rd_ogre are creatures to hit and be hit, t_rd_lifelinker proves the gain follows the doubled number, and t_rd_bolt is an instant so a non-combat source can be measured. t_rd_tyrant is Twinflame Tyrant, the one card that names both halves of the recipient -- a seat and a permanent -- and reads its dealer off control alone; t_rd_emancipation is Fiery Emancipation, the same 'a source you control' dealer with no recipient named, so the source widening can be measured on its own; t_rd_scourge names only the seat, so the permanent half can be shown absent; and t_rd_scorch is an instant that can be aimed at either player, which is how a spell -- a source that is on the stack rather than the battlefield -- gets measured.
